title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Chain
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：elephant　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 elephant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my grandfather ① led an elephant that no keeper in the forest would have named, and he said the leading was the whole of the summer. The ② elephant, meaning the animal and not the problem, walked fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; an elephant, he said, is the only thing in a forest that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ elephant in that forest had the same short chain at the end of it, and the ④ elephant at the end, meaning the one they kept for the festival and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An elephant, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to lead; my grandfather said the leading is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the elephant was the whole of the story, meaning the problem and not the animal. The ⑥ elephant, meaning the problem and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody walks round and nobody names; elephant, he said, is either something you lead or the only word that means both an animal and a problem. He said the problem is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ elephant had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short chain. The ⑧ elephant of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in July, was one forest and fourteen summers of leading; elephant, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to lead. She said the leading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ elephant I remember is the one named in the register, which died in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the forest. An ⑩ elephant, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being led; every elephant, she said, is a problem that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the problem was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 象；大象（指那片林子里牵过的那一只）
B. n. 象；大象（指那只象本身，与庞然大物般的难题相对）
C. 固定搭配：lead an elephant 牵一只象
D. n. 象；大象（指留给节庆的那一只）

F. n. 象；大象（指册子上写到、被列名的那一只）
G. n. 庞然大物；棘手的难题（指故事里人人都绕开却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 棘手的难题（抽象总称，指人人都绕开却无人说出的那种难题）

answers.why: lead an elephant 意为“牵一只象”，1956 年祖父牵了一只林子里没有一位饲养员肯叫出名字的象。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，指那只象本身而不是棘手的难题，它走了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，指那片林子里的每一只象，每一只到头都有同一根短短的链子。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，指留给节庆的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
elephant 意为“庞然大物、棘手的难题”，指故事里人人都绕开却无人说出的那样东西，叔叔说这个难题就是那个故事的全部。
elephant 意为“棘手的难题”，指人人都绕开却无人说出的那种难题而不是那只象，是故事里人人都绕开、却无人说出的东西。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，指册子上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1965 年这只象成了册子里的一行。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，祖父七月写道，整件事的牵象之事是一片林子和十四个夏天的牵引。
elephant 意为“象、大象”，我记得的是册子上列名的那一只，1977 年死了，至今仍被说成林子里最安静的一只。
elephant 为抽象总称，祖母 1979 年说，一只象是唯一会因为被好好牵引而变得更好的生灵。
